title: Email testing pages, a welcome email and share previews
items: New comparisons with Mailtrap, Mailosaur and MailSlurp, and an email testing section on the compare page
The email testing page and the Playwright guide are rewritten around signup, magic link, one-time code and password reset tests
New accounts get one getting-started email with the CLI, MCP and SDK setup
Compare, provider and blog pages show their own image when a link is shared
The DocuSign page lists Connect's events and explains its HMAC signatures, and the smee.io comparison says what smee.io is and how to use it
The API reference and openapi.yaml cover destinations, previews, replay, raw email, attachments, claims and team endpoints
